scenes.setting: The handover in the prayer hall, conducted like an arms deal: the walnut-like mutated pituitary gland tugs at Klein's digested potion (the convergence of same-pathway characteristics), 1,450 pounds counted from five paces, and a match-flame exit that leaves Emlyn mourning 'My suitcase… My tin box…'

A carriage to Empress Borough: Fors explains why ingredients keep and potions don't (a glass bottle left too long will 'drink' it and wake up), mourns what her Tarot Club purchases were really worth — then sees Mr. A's gathering house collapsed and scorched, and orders the driver two streets on
scenes.text_anchor: There was a fierce battle here…

scenes.setting: 'Aurora Order's base found' in the morning paper, the ingredients safely stowed above the fog and 735 pounds left; then the Lucky Bar, where Carlson already knows about the Creator preachers — until Klein mentions a Fourth Epoch noble's tomb and pauses to order a beer
scenes.text_anchor: “I have a clue regarding a Fourth Epoch tomb of a noble.”
